en: A multi-view black-and-white postcard showing several scenes related to Burg Kriebstein and its surroundings. The central image depicts a medieval hilltop castle rising above a rocky, wooded river valley. Other panels show a church-like interior with an ornate painted vaulted ceiling and altar, paintings or artwork associated with the castle, and river or reservoir views with boats and forested hills. In the lower center there is white Gothic-style German text on a black background.
